fallback: Volcanion Rock Slide, Swampert Waterfall, Zapdos Discharge. Reassess public HP, switches, criticals; no blind full sweep.
capture: Zapdos Thunder Wave, Mega Mawile Swords Dance and False Swipe. Wild125 last moves Future Sight/Natural Gift/Calm Mind/Sky Attack; no recoil or Recover. Keep capture separate from boss clip.
